config.claim: Development-only method-level independent reconstruction of Sun et al. (2024) Stage 3 (matching score + three violation scores). Method evidence: Sun 2024 paper section 4.3 Definitions 4-7 and section 5.3 (Tables 9/11 for tau, Figure 8 for gamma). Not exact reproduction, not Sun original implementation, not paper-faithful unless all public rules are verified item by item. Development implementation verified; formal completion blocked on S1.7 and S2.13.

paper_sections.matching: Definition 4 (Matching Score): Dr,m = rule actions -> highest-similarity process action; Or,m = rule actors -> highest-similarity process business-object/actor; matching(r,m,tau) = max( fraction of Dr,m with sim>tau, fraction of Or,m with sim>tau )
paper_sections.missing_action: Definition 5: action violation(r,m,gamma) = |{(ar,am) in Dr,m | sim(ar,am)<gamma}| / |Ar|
paper_sections.incorrect_actor: Definition 6: R = rule actors assigned to a matched activity (sim>gamma); C = process actors executing the same action; actor violation = |{r in R | exists r' in C, sim(r,r')<theta}| / |R|
paper_sections.out_of_order: Definition 7: Ur,m,gamma = order constraints whose both endpoints map with sim>gamma; order violation = (|Ur,m,gamma| - |satisfied order constraints (forward reachable, not backward)|) / |Ur,m,gamma|

thresholds.tau_source: Sun 2024 Table 9 / Table 11: most models reach highest AP/MAP at tau=0.8 (9 of 12 and 4 of 4)
thresholds.gamma_source: Sun 2024 Figure 8: violation-detection precision is highest at gamma=0.8 for most models
thresholds.theta_source: pre-registered development setting: Sun 2024 Figure 9 reports that two of the four GDPR models reach their highest incorrect-actor precision at theta=0.8 and the other two at theta=0.7 (gamma fixed at 0.8); 0.8 is the project's fixed pre-registration, reported together with a theta sweep
thresholds.note: sweeps are sensitivity reports only; primary thresholds are NOT selected from this project's data

matching_evaluation.primary: ranking AP per process and MAP (recommender metrics per Sun section 5.3.1); binary relevance uses the pre-registered rule matching_score > tau and is reported separately

similarity_backend.note: same backend as the Winter baseline for a controlled comparison; differences come from Rule Record structure (action/actor separation, order relations), not from a stronger model; no download, no network

bpmn_membership_contract.purpose: frozen S3.1 all-seven GDPR BPMN membership

stage1_structural_contract.purpose: canonical Process Record parser contract (activities/events/control-flow reachability)

gold_annotation_blank_pack.purpose: 58 frozen candidates with embedded rule_text; NO decisions read by the runner

winter_lexicon_dir.role: EXTERNAL read-only provenance: signalwords.txt for obligation detection in the development Rule Record adapter

rule_record_adapter.method: deterministic spaCy dependency extraction: sentence split -> obligation sentences (signalword) -> actor (nsubj/nsubjpass), action (ROOT verb phrase + objects), order relations (sequence markers 'after'/'then' + sentence order)
differences_from_full_stage2_rules_only: full Stage 2 Rules-Only = BERT-TextCNN modality classifier + CoreNLP/Tregex/Tsurgeon phrase extraction + public marker lexicon (not run here: external CoreNLP runtime not available)
this adapter uses only spaCy dependency parsing and the shared signalword lexicon
no B0 predictions are used; adapter output is marked development-only and must not be presented as formal B0

process_record_input.source: canonical Process Record via configs/stage1_structural_s11_s14.json parser (src/bpc_hybrid/stage1_process.py)
process_record_input.observability_note: lanes carry empty names in the frozen GDPR7 files; pools carry names (e.g. 'Data Controller'); actor checks use pool + non-empty lane names; empty actor semantics are reported as unobservable, never inferred from Gold

evaluator.note: no compliant (none) gold items exist in the frozen violation pack, so specificity/compliant accuracy is N/A
